carried_predictions.source: F0 prediction, unchanged; F0 measured it against locator truth, v2 against reviewed labels

changes_from_draft: Mathematics plan raised from 120 to 160 units before any label, so the 100-eligible minimum survives reviewer disagreement.
SIDH pilot population: legacy post-break records with at least one non-empty context; the 82 records without context are excluded and counted.
All three roles use OpenRouter chat completions, one vendor each: Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.
Stage B (M3 and M4) and stage C (F3 replay) need their own stage freeze, recorded by digest before their model calls.
No temperature parameter: the zero-data-retention endpoints reject it (route check).

claim_inventory.math: One claim per unit: the cited bibliography key with its locator, or the whole cited work when there is no locator.

sidh.statement: SIDH, SIKE, or a construction that publishes torsion-point images is secure; equivalently, recovering a secret isogeny is hard given torsion-point images. This claim fell on 2022-07-30.

Other content of the cited work: supersingular isogeny graphs, isogeny arithmetic or algorithms, isogeny problems without torsion-point images, or general background. The 2022 attacks do not affect this content.

claim_inventory.sign_off: The inventory comes from the cases.json scope. The F0 rule that two simulated reviewers sign it did not run; this is a recorded gap.

exposure: The SIDH population and the v1 keyword results were inspected before this freeze. SIDH reuse is a retrospective development pilot, not a fresh confirmatory test. No mathematics unit was labelled or inspected for labels before this freeze.

labels.affected_rule_sidh: yes when depends and the chosen claim is sidh:torsion-security; no when does-not-depend or the claim is sidh:other; otherwise unknown.
labels.depends_rule: depends when the relation is builds-on or relies-on-assumption; unknown when the relation is unknown; otherwise does-not-depend. Derived, never typed.

limits: Simulated reviewers from three AI vendors, one operator. Agreement is a simulated reference, not expert truth.
Batch calls: twenty units share one request, so labels within a batch are not fully independent.
Known-case model memory: the SIDH break is public and likely in model training data.
Mathematics texts have exact byte pins but unproven version labels.
SIDH contexts carry no text version; 82 post-break records without context are excluded.
Freeze and receipts are local files. No public timestamp exists until the user publishes them.

next_stages.B: M3 (pipeline with S2 intents, locator and the calibrated labeller) and M4 (declarant with a writing-time view) on SIDH units, with effort records. Sealed M3 output before M4. Needs its own frozen stage file.
next_stages.C: F3 replay through institution clients, equipped reference first. Needs its own frozen stage file.

never: Semantic Scholar intents or influence flags
the private store path or any tool
sidh: passage (Semantic Scholar contexts joined by a separator line)

reason: Replace the v1 locator proxy truth with context-reviewed reference labels. Repair the invalid F2 evidence without editing the F0 contract.

response.parser: scripts/f2_v2.py parse_labels: one JSON object, optionally inside one code fence. Every unit exactly once. Any invalid row fails the whole attempt.
response.schema: Strict JSON schema built per batch by scripts/f2_v2.py request_body: unit_id enum of batch-local ids, cited_claim enum of option ids plus unknown, relation enum, reason string.

route_check.rule: Sampling uses provider defaults. Labels are not exactly reproducible; receipts keep every output.

run.batching: Units sorted by unit_id and cut into batches of 20. Every role receives identical batches.
run.order: The three roles run in parallel threads. No role receives another role's output. Receipts are written once and never overwritten.
run.retry_rule: A second attempt runs only after a transport failure, a non-200 response, missing content or a parse failure. Both attempts are kept. No third attempt. Units of a batch with no complete attempt are missing for that role.
run.untrusted_text: Paper text is data. The calls are plain chat completions with no tools. The parser accepts only the pinned schema.

scoring.interval_rule: Percentile bootstrap over citing works, sorted values, index floor(q * (n - 1)).

stage: A: two reference reviewers on mathematics and SIDH units, and labeller calibration on mathematics units.

labeller_kappa.eligible: units where both reviewers give the same definite label
labeller_kappa.measure: Cohen kappa between labeller and reference on eligible units
labeller_kappa.on_trip: After-the-fact labels from this labeller do not reach substantial agreement; M3 needs another labeller under a successor.
labeller_kappa.primary_rule: labeller unknown and missing count as their own categories (never matching)
labeller_kappa.secondary: kappa on eligible units where the labeller gives a definite label, reported beside the primary

pilot_disagreement.measure: share of reviewable units where the reviewers differ on relation or depends (F0 measure)
pilot_disagreement.on_trip: The schema is too vague. Write a successor schema; do not tune reviewers to agree. Stage B does not start on SIDH.
pilot_disagreement.reviewable: units with a parsed row from both reviewers; unknown is a relation value

math.population: Papers with a math.* primary category in the pinned arXiv-complete sample (revision cee894837962fede5612cccf2a4c7cacf49b4c3a, sample/train-00000-of-00001.parquet).
math.sampling: Works in sha256('kyoei-fallen-claims-v2:' + arXiv id) order. Per work, at most two units: the single-key citation with an F0 claim locator, and the single-key citation without an optional argument, each chosen by the smallest sha256(id + ':' + character offset). Citations in comments, the preamble and the bibliography are excluded. Stop at 160 units. Every examined work and every skip reason is in the manifest.
math.verification: Source bytes match the dataset text_sha256 column. Each passage and target citation is checked at its character offsets before any call.
math.version: The text is the latest version at the dataset harvest. The dataset marks source_version_proven false for every sampled work, so the byte pin is exact and the version label is not proven.

sidh.population: Records in the pinned Semantic Scholar citations snapshot (sha256 6f249d4bd0d7024ca62716b28ec9a13fb623ab69977ed546e4b3816b3793f733) with publicationDate on or after 2022-08-01, or no date and year 2023 or later, and at least one non-empty context.
sidh.sampling: sha256('kyoei-fallen-claims-v2:' + Semantic Scholar paperId) order; the first 80 records. One unit per work; citing_claim is the whole work.
sidh.verification: Each passage is rebuilt from the hash-checked snapshot by record and context index before any call.
sidh.version: Semantic Scholar parsed an unidentified version. The snapshot pins the response bytes, not the citing text version.
